abstract: PCI Health Training Center was founded by Dr. Roy Rose as the Academy for Medical and Dental Assistants in 1978. Receiving initial accreditation in 1983, we were acquired by Prince Careers Inc. in 1990 and switched to our current name. In 2005, we opened a branch campus in Richardson, TX.
